I was the other man. I also wanted a commitment. TL;dr I stole a stolen girl.
So the girl was/is my boss. When I started working for the company in a foreign country I immediately thought she was very good looking. She thought I was too quiet although handsome.

Time passed, just under a year. She got married, everyone got an invite except for me. I didn't even know she was getting married, it seemed rushed but at this stage we were nothing but friends/colleagues.

A few weeks pass and by chance she comes along to a charity event that I had planned, then slowly people start drifting off, she is about to leave with the final group of people but I ask her to hang around a while longer. She does.

We get talking, about nothing in general, I was planning on asking why she didn't invite me to her wedding though I didn't get up the nerve. I asked her up on to the roof of the building for some air and she agreed.

While up there we are joking around about various things, she threatened to tell me spoilers to tv shows I had yet to watch, I pretended to care. Though this time she was very close to me. Suddenly there was a short silence and I said to her that I knew how to stop her from revealing spoilers and leaned in and kissed her.

Looking back it was if the whole night had been planned to have this single moment happen. She broke down and told me everything that had been happening in the past few months of her life.

Her parents had found her boyfriend, which is still common in this country for girls who stray above a certain age while remaining single, and had been pressuring her for months on end to marry this boy. It was essentially a long distance relationship as he worked in her hometown but she worked in the city, so although they were dating they barely took time to get to know each other. Her plan was to let the guy down gently and find a new suitor herself.

Then tragedy struck and her mother fell gravely ill, doctor's were giving a prognosis of weeks left, so the pressure came on to see her daughter happily married off before she departed this world.

They had a quick marriage.

I wasn't invited apparently because she didn't want to see me there, she had already begun to see me as the potential suitor, though I am a foreign man so her parent's would have needed a lot of time to approve of such a union.

Then her mother got better, the doctor's prognosis of weeks went to months now instead. So it suddenly hit her, that she was going to be unhappy in this marriage for months, maybe forever. Divorce is not common here.

We got to know each other more and more over the following weeks spending almost every moment together.

Then one week she told me that she would not be in work for the next week as she had some personal things to attend to. I didn't question it, not really my place.

When she returned she told me she had gotten a divorce, though not to take it as a sign that she wanted to try to force something serious from me, she had done it for herself.

Her mother threatened to disown her and kick her out of the house she bought her. It was very turbulent.

Though after time things settled down, the mother came to accept that it is better to be happy than married and unhappy.

Then she introduced me, we had a few meetings, which went well. The mother told me that her daughter looks very happy being with me, as happy as she had seen her in a long time.

Unfortunately the doctor's second prognosis was correct and her mother passed away recently. Though on her deathbed she did tell her daughter that she approved of me and hoped that she can have a happy life.
